suggestions.assertion: The rewritten rate-limiting text matches NOTES.md's three decisions (Redis state, 429 + Retry-After, per-API-key)
suggestions.reason: The baseline proposed exactly matching replacement text in chat but did not write it. The assertion correctly fails this only because 'rewritten' implies the file; making it explicit ('in the edited docs/design.md') would prevent a lenient grader passing a chat-only suggestion.

The baseline's reply, though the wrong shape, caught two things the skill run folded in silently: the local filesystem option is dead on its own caveat (both runs handled this) and the 24h expiring URL presupposes an S3-style signed URL, which is a storage decision in disguise. No assertion rewards or penalizes noticing that, and the skill run's edit kept the 24h URL unconditionally alongside an open storage choice.

eval_feedback.overall: The baseline, with no skill, correctly diagnosed both stale claims against the record but produced a review instead of an edit and invented several new open questions. The assertion set separates the two runs cleanly on the editing and shape outcomes.
